verdict.rationale: Postman has a programmatic API, an official CLI and an MCP server, so issuing scoped credentials for an agent is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens that could be issued to an agent. The role and permission controls for team members (postman-docs-14) are an adjacent feature for human access, not scoped credential issuance, so they earn no credit.
